page.layout: One column of running text. Below it, faint lines in a lower block (partly illegible). One marginal note in the left margin beside the line "mauit, gloriam Dei".

main_text.p: maieftatem eius , quandoquidem cognitio eius non eft illi expofita ad voluntatem animi. His fermonibus & confimilibus argumentis appel- latus à Themiftio Imperator Valens lenior in orthodoxos effectus eft. Quòd fi natura duce humaniter cogitandum in caufa religionis de hominibus effe iudicauit Philofophus ignarus veritatis, vtens axiomate quòd Sapiens confir- mauit, Prou.25.gloriam Dei effe celare verbum : fi Philofophi illius monitis fractus eft quodammodo Valentis Imperatoris animus, qui fanguinem & cædes Chriftianorum tanta ferocitate spirauerat; quid nos Chriftianos, obfecro, nescire est facere erga ignorantes aut errantes quofque? quibus fermonibus reuocare in viam? qua commiseratione animi dies & noctes de miferorum errantium institutione & falute laborare? Hoc nos omnes docet, hucducit natu- ra ipsa, & humanus ordo, & diuinus ordo, & communis Ecclefiæ, & priuata fingulorum de gratia falutari Dei experientia, & constantissimè Dei ex verbo ipsius testificatione quibus omnibus nos præstat cedere, quàm particulari corruptioni naturæ nostræ in nostrath[?] ipsorum & aliorum perniciem obsequi[?] [illegible, ~20 letters]

page.notes: The lower part of the page (below "obfequi") is faint, rubbed and partly overprinted by show-through; the lines there could not be read reliably and are marked illegible. "Prou.25." in the left margin and "nostrath" are doubtful. The running head is printed in spaced capitals and read as EIRENICI; the page number 162 is at the top left. Long s has been normalised to s.
